question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**or**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the health problems that obese children might face as they grow up.
 
• The conjunction in the blank needs to link "high blood pressure" and "diabetes" as two that obese children might face.
 
• "**Or**" is the appropriate conjunction for listing alternative possibilities in this context.
 
• Other options ("**neither**", "**nor**", "**never**") do not fit grammatically or logically in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Many parents think of overweight children as ‘cute’ and cuddly. However, obesity must not be 1.* *seen__* *as a healthy sign. 2. __**When**__ obese children grow up, they will be more prone 3. __**to**__ health problems like high blood pressure 4. __**or**__ diabetes. Today, overweight children are becoming a common 5. __**sight**__ in many countries.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Neither (ना ही) : "Neither" is used to negate two or more items and does not fit this positive context.
 
• Nor (और ना ही): "Nor" normally follows "neither" and does not fit without it.
 
• Never (कभी नहीं): "Never" is an adverb indicating negation over time, which does not fit the context here.
